title: Project facts for the Trident literature-review conversation
provenance: author-supplied project-record summary, 2026-10-20; underlying repository links not independently opened

decisions.prediction_contract: Autonomous: geometry/properties/closures/heater/secondary cooling/ambient inputs; primary temperatures and circulation outputs. Measured-primary-temperature-driven models are conditional diagnostics.
decisions.reactor_mapping: Not selected; retain liquid-fuel, non-fueled salt transport and FHR branches without choosing one.
decisions.thermal_limits: Allowable heat flux and material/sensor temperature limits, not boiling CHF; numeric tolerances unresolved.
decisions.facility_mapping: VCU experimental lane is STNCL; not a third facility or TAMU loop. VCU working fluid Prop-30 glycol, exact product/concentration/properties unresolved. ACU separate candidate HITEC branch.
decisions.observations: VCU primary PTC1–4 are centerline observations, not established bulk temperatures. STCs pipe contact. No direct VCU primary flow or local-flow measurements. ACU flowmeter author-reported but calibration/range/synchronization unverified.
decisions.covariance: Secondary duty derived from flow and enthalpy difference is not independent of those ingredients; inferred primary flow is correlated with its energy inputs. Type A residual studies are not total sensor accuracy or zero Type B bias.
decisions.experiments: Nick Rev0.1 phases are written proposals with blank approvals, not executed/frozen holdouts. P2 passive response identifies supported ratios/combinations; known power anchors require observability checks. P3 validate frozen P2 before refit; Phase4 no primary refit in proposal.
decisions.model_hierarchy: M1 no flow steady energy; M2 prescribed flow energy; M3 scalar buoyancy–resistance steady flow. Implemented, not facility validated. Existing measured-primary-temperature-driven wall transient is conditional.
decisions.cfd: No qualified TRIDENT fields/run manifest/regime/resources/date; thesis S35 is external evidence and does not imply project CFD access.
decisions.data_boundaries: ACU processing hold preserved. Voltage is not watts. Air-filled ambient runs are not glycol circulation tests; grouped July14 records are not continuous trajectories.
decisions.insulation: VCU Rev9 working topology separates insulated legs/corners, ceramic-strip heater, bare straight cooler/top and jacketed section; a local sensor patch does not define an entire segment.
decisions.collaboration: Ben Booth/NeutronOS dashboard collaboration active; no stand-alone novelty claim.
